payload.summary: CME: render the claim-pack button on a reachable CME surface (follow-up to #G20QE6)
payload.detail: CmeClaimPackButton and its unit tests exist in src/components/cme/cme-claim-pack.tsx, but nothing imports or renders it, so clinicians cannot reach the study-budget export. Wire it into a reachable CME page with a user-facing test before closing.
